title: Player attack poses
note: Warrior, Rogue, Ranger, Monk, Bard and Druid: two main attacks (plain), then an ability (a short thrust streak and sparks), then a spell (the casters lift the staff, the off hand glows).

title: Greyfang howls on the run
note: The final take: he keeps running and throws his head back in a drawn howl pose for about a second, with short sound lines pulsing from his jaws. No stop and no charge (owner: that reused the boar's mechanic).

title: Greyfang stops to howl, then rushes
note: He stops, throws his head back in a real howl pose with his mouth open while short sound lines pulse from his jaws, crouches for a moment, then rushes in kicking up dust to catch up.

title: Greyfang's Howl, toned down
note: The v0.107 howl was way too much (owner). Now he just leans back with his nose up and three short sound lines pulse from his jaws, like a Pokemon cry. His pack lift their heads a moment later and come.

title: Greyfang's Howl
note: When you pull him he rears up and throws his head back, cold breath smokes from his jaws, and rings of sound roll out across the wood. Each pack wolf the rings reach flashes its eyes and lifts its head to answer, then they come. Also the new, smaller pack wolves.

title: Skeleton death
note: The body caves in, the bones spill into a little mound, and the skull hangs a beat, then drops on top and bounces once. The first family death.

title: The Skeleton King's death
note: Same death, bigger pile. His skull keeps its crown, cut from his own picture. (The blue column is his loot drop.)

title: Bone Throw
note: While the purple bar fills he raises a bone and grave-light gathers into it, then it spins in an arc and cracks apart on you. Out of range, it clatters to the floor.

title: Three on you
note: Each skeleton leans back, then lunges on its own swing, with a pale slash across you, so you can count them.

title: Teaser, draft 3
note: 49 seconds recorded from the real game with fake players: the crossroads, a class montage, a flash of the Skeleton King, the Drowned Prior's Grasp. Personal use only.
